description: This file contains multiple reusable React components for formatting and displaying various data types such as timestamps, durations, file sizes, execution IDs, and status indicators within a web UI. It also includes utility functions for text highlighting and status health visualization.

methods.name: DurationDisplay
methods.description: Component to format and display durations from milliseconds, with optional icon.

methods.name: TimestampDisplay
methods.description: Component to format and display timestamps in relative, absolute, or smart format.

methods.name: FileSizeDisplay
methods.description: Component to format and display file sizes in B, KB, MB, GB.

methods.name: ExecutionIdDisplay
methods.description: Component to display, optionally truncate, and copy execution IDs.

methods.name: DataSizeComparison
methods.description: Component to compare input/output data sizes with optional icons.

methods.name: AgentCapabilitySummary
methods.description: Component providing a summary of agent reasoners and skills counts.

methods.name: PercentageDisplay
methods.description: Component to display percentage values with configurable decimals.

methods.name: MetricDisplay
methods.description: Component to display labeled numeric or string metrics with optional icons.

methods.name: highlightSearchText
methods.description: Utility function to emphasize search query matches within a text.

methods.name: StatusHealthDisplay
methods.description: Component to display status with optional health percentage indicator and color coding.
